name: testing-best-practices
title_zh: 先问「这测试删了谁心疼」再动手写的 Laravel
tagline_zh: 不背 Pest 语法手册，专治「覆盖率 90% 但全是假断言」。按业务价值挑测试、拆依赖、卡 HTTP 边界。
tagline_en: No syntax handbook. Picks tests by business value, not coverage. Cuts fake assertions, isolates deps, guards HTTP.
desc_en: Laravel test design and review. Use when selecting coverage, naming or structuring tests, choosing assertions or test data, isolating dependencies, testing HTTP or security boundaries, improving suite performance, or reviewing test value. Use framework guidance or search-docs for Pest and PHPUnit syntax.
why_zh: 它把「测试有没有价值」当第一关：先删后写。用「谁会心疼」逼你直面冗余，再给结构、断言、隔离的具体改法。
why_en: Makes value the gate: delete first, then write. 'Who'd miss it?' forces you to face redundancy, then gives concrete fixes for.
limit_zh: 只评审 Laravel/PHPUnit/Pest 的测试代码，不生成新测试。依赖你已有测试文件。
limit_en: Reviews existing Laravel/PHPUnit/Pest tests only; writes no new tests. Needs your test files present; flags coverage gaps without filling them.
title_en: Laravel test review that asks who'd miss it before writing
